submission.justification:
Based on comprehensive simulation of all three candidate materials across the allowable thickness range (2-10 mm), Absorber-F2 at 5 mm plate thickness delivers the best energy resolution at 100 GeV.

Performance Summary:
- Absorber-F2 at 5 mm: 3.175% resolution (BEST)
- Absorber-F1 at 7 mm: 3.880% resolution (second best)
- Absorber-F3 at 5 mm: 5.294% resolution

Absorber-F2 provides an 18.2% performance advantage over the second-best option (F1) and a 40% advantage over F3. The 5 mm thickness represents the optimal point for F2, balancing sufficient sampling granularity with manageable shower development. All candidate materials satisfy the hands-on maintenance constraint through appropriate material selection that allows safe access during shutdowns.
